mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL index values exceeding 235 indicate elevated inflation, triggering hawkish monetary policy expectations that depress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Labor market overheating (UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 500) precedes Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 500, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to weakening economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in residential construction (HOUST) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and GDPC1 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) creates a regime where delayed Fed tightening depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 235 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, the S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
